molecules.jmol_script:
load "$MANUSCRIPT/tmp/jmol_final/Criegee_Intermediate.xyz"
background white
set frank off
set antialiasDisplay true
set antialiasImages true
set perspectiveDepth false
select all
spacefill 23%
wireframe 0.09
color atoms CPK
select carbon
color atoms [x535B66]
select hydrogen
color atoms [xF0F0EC]
select all
set ambientPercent 42
set diffusePercent 78
set specularPercent 28
rotate x 18
rotate y -12
rotate z -5
zoom 85
write image 1000 650 PNG "$MANUSCRIPT/tmp/jmol_final/Criegee_Intermediate.png"
